cortico-bot-continuity.description: Cortico 的 Bot 扩展，为机器人带来持续的记忆和鲜明的个性，记住经历，整理往事，延续对话。
cortico-bot-continuity.author: DTMosken

cortico-bot-memory.description: Cortico bot 模板:在 Persona 层面复现五层长期记忆(事实库/知识库/反思/人格/档案 + 三级底座 + 混合检索),记忆归 bot 私有,经系统前缀注入、对话实时沉淀,无需 world。

zh.description: Cortico bot 扩展：在 Persona 层面复现五层长期记忆（事实库 / 知识库 / 反思 / 人格 / 档案 + 三级底座 + 混合检索），记忆归 bot 私有，经系统前缀注入、对话实时沉淀，无需 world。

en.description: A Cortico bot extension that replicates a five-layer long-term memory system at the Persona level (fact base / knowledge base / reflection / persona / profile + three-tier base + hybrid retrieval). Memory is bot-private, injected via the system prefix and accumulated live from conversations, with no world required.

cortico-bot-memory.author: hth768

cortico-bot-qq-persona.description: QQ 机器人内部状态 Persona:情绪(mood)/好感度(affinity)/外号(alias)作为 bot 内部状态经系统前缀注入,不重复主模型工作(维护者评审 Pal-AI-Lab/cortico-extensions#104 的拆分项)。
cortico-bot-qq-persona.author: hth768

cortico-bot-weighted-memory.description: 分区权重记忆：Cortico Persona 与 Memory 扩展，支持有证据事件摘要、分区预算、人工审核和版本回滚。
cortico-bot-weighted-memory.author: Kpect10086

cortico-bot-xiaoshen-alont1.description: 小深人格的 Cortico bot 扩展（默认种子已脱敏，可替换）
cortico-bot-xiaoshen-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-bot-zcor.description: Cortico bot with persistent memory, local recall and relationship tracking

cortico-frugal-alont1.description: Cortico bot 省 token 体检：先按账本量出钱花在哪，再按规则收紧那些「一轮太贵」的配置项（只收紧、先备份、默认只看不改）
cortico-frugal-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-provider-chatgpt.description: Sign in with ChatGPT for Cortico, with account controls and remote callback completion in WebUI
cortico-provider-chatgpt.author: zhiyuxl

cortico-provider-coo.description: Coo Pet Provider: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Doubao, MiniMax, StepFun, Baidu Qianfan, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and xAI for Cortico, over Responses, Chat Completions, the Messages API or the Gemini API; and a ChatGPT plan through Sign in with
cortico-provider-coo.author: Pal AI Lab

cortico-provider-deepseek.description: Cortico 的 DeepSeek Responses API 模型供应商扩展，支持峰谷计价与关闭、低、高、最大四档思考。
cortico-provider-deepseek.author: DTMosken

cortico-provider-gemini-web.description: Cortico 的 Gemini Web Provider（Windows）：通过内嵌 Electron 使用已登录的 Gemini 网页。必须与 cortico-world-gemini-web 同时安装，二者互为刚需。

cortico-tool-junction-upgrade.description: 跳过 Coopanion 市场 24 小时发布间隔，用 junction 方式把已安装的 cortico 扩展直接升级到指定版本。
cortico-tool-junction-upgrade.author: hth768

cortico-world-affinity-alont1.description: 好感度 World：按账号记住关系分数与档位，模型回话前查一下该用什么态度；分数可涨可跌，还会随疏远衰减
cortico-world-affinity-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-agenda.description: Cortico World: 日程与便签 —— 到点把一条提示投给她并当场叫醒(循环闹钟 / 定时 / 一次性,错过只补一次),外加一册两人共写、开机整册交给她的便签。控制台有两个页签。要求 Cortico 0.2.0 及以上。 ★ 支持 Coopanion(Coo):已在 Coopanion 0.2.5 上装机验证;出问题可去 GitHub 提 issue,或到 QQ 群里 @筆離嘢(与作者名同名)。

en.description: Cortico World: a shared schedule that wakes the bot with a prompt at its due minute (repeat interval, cron or one-shot; missed periods are caught up once), plus a shared notepad delivered in full whenever the World starts. Two console tabs. Requires Cortico 0.2.0 or later. ★ Runs in Coopanion (Coo): installed and verified on Coopanion 0.2.5. Problems: open an issue on GitHub, or ping @筆離嘢 in the QQ group (same name as the author).

cortico-world-agenda.author: 筆離嘢

cortico-world-album-alont1.description: 相册 World：把收到过、发出去的图存成一份能翻的册子——按人、按时间、按会话都找得回来，看过还能自己写一句这是什么
cortico-world-album-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-alive-alont1.description: 能动性 World：让 bot 自己排期想做的事（到点把它写下的原话还给它）、有自己的时间、每天回顾一次，并看得见你在桌面上干什么、花了多少钱、它眼前那份规矩是怎么拼的——全部只读
cortico-world-alive-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-asr.description: Cortico World: microphone speech recognition — RtAudio capture, energy-gated segmentation, FireRedASR2-AED backend, subtitle overlay
cortico-world-asr.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-audio.description: Cortico World: 音频理解（Qwen2-Audio 本地模型）——听一段音频，说出它在放什么（音乐类型/情绪/歌词大意），也能把语音转成文字。

cortico-world-audio-play.description: 音频播放（Audio Play）—— 给 Coopanion 桌宠的 cortico World 扩展：把 log:/mem: 音频句柄或本地音频文件交给系统扬声器播放，只回成功或失败。 / A cortico World extension that plays a log:/mem: audio handle or a local audio file through the system speakers and reports only the outcome.
cortico-world-audio-play.author: AqualCross

cortico-world-bilibili.description: Cortico World: read-only Bilibili live room — danmaku, gifts, super chats and guard events, with a local transparent overlay
cortico-world-bilibili.author: Pal AI Lab

cortico-world-bilibili-video.description: Cortico World: watch a bilibili video in a logged-in browser, with frames, subtitles and the video's own danmaku delivered as events. 此乃直播测试验证之后的world，和其他 Persona / 非直播场景的兼容性有待测试。
cortico-world-bilibili-video.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-break.description: Cortico World: 久坐与喝水提醒 — 到点让 Coo 冒个泡，只在你确实在电脑前时开口
cortico-world-break.author: ding

cortico-world-browser.description: Cortico World: 浏览器 —— 她能搜索、开页、读页、点击、填表、上传、截图，也能陪看 B 站视频（画面拼图、字幕与弹幕），共用浏览器与登录态。★ 非即插即用：装完包还不能用，要先装上游 web-access，填 worlds.browser.skillDir、选浏览器并打开远程调试，否则 World 起不来。要求 Cortico 0.2.0 及以上。 ★ 支持 Coopanion(Coo):0.2.5 上实测通过。有问题请提 GitHub issue,或到 QQ 群 @筆離嘢。

en.description: Cortico World: a managed browser the bot can search, open, read, click, fill, upload and screenshot, plus Bilibili video watching with frame mosaics, subtitles and danmaku. ★ Not plug-and-play: installing the package is not enough. Install the upstream web-access project first, set worlds.browser.skillDir, pick the browser and enable its remote debugging, or the World will not start. Requires Cortico 0.2.0 or later. ★ Runs in Coopanion (Coo): installed and verified on Coopanion 0.2.5. Problems: open an issue on GitHub, or ping @筆離嘢 in the QQ group (same name as the author).

cortico-world-browser.author: 筆離嘢

cortico-world-buckshot.description: Buckshot Roulette game events and player actions for Cortico. 此乃直播测试验证之后的world，和其他 Persona / 非直播场景的兼容性有待测试。

cortico-world-canvas.description: Cortico World: a drawing studio and a draw-and-guess game — p5.brush strokes rendered in a headless browser, served as a live board
cortico-world-canvas.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-clipboard-alont1.description: 剪贴板 World：读当前剪贴板里的文字（默认关闭，Windows 专用）。你刚复制的东西她能接住
cortico-world-clipboard-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-clock-alont1.description: 现在几点 World：把钟点和时段交给她——一天里的时间线索本来只有消息自带的时间戳，久没人说话就断了
cortico-world-clock-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-coocowork.description: Cortico World for Coopanion: Coo keeps you company while you work, with the activity, focus sessions and calendar it can see
cortico-world-coocowork.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-cortidrive.description: Cortico World for Teach my little sister how to drive, with the bot in the driver seat: a BepInEx plugin replaces the sister model with the bot's drive tool and turns game calls into events. 此乃直播测试验证之后的world，和其他 Persona / 非直播场景的兼容性有待测试。

cortico-world-cosyvoice-tts.description: CosyVoice 3 TTS output for Coopanion desktop-pet pet_say calls

cortico-world-cua-alont1.description: 电脑操作：看见并操作这台电脑的主屏幕（截图/鼠标/键盘/窗口）。原生调用隔离在引擎子进程，与使用者共用电脑时会让路；默认只读，动手要主人显式打开
cortico-world-cua-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-diary-alont1.description: 截图日记 World：截一张当前屏幕存进当天日记，可以附一句。只截主屏、不主动传出去（Windows 专用，默认关闭）
cortico-world-diary-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-downloads-alont1.description: 下载管家 World：看下载夹最近下了什么、占多大；新东西落地时冒一句。不移动、不删除文件
cortico-world-downloads-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-draw-alont1.description: 本地生图：调 MOSS-Image（ComfyUI）画图，默认二次元日漫风格。画完把图存到自己的 dir，也能直接看
cortico-world-draw-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-dungeon.description: Cortico World for Cortico Dungeon Alpha: a persistent multi-bot world with production, crafting and turn-based raids

cortico-world-eat.description: 吃饭（Eat）—— 给 Coopanion 桌宠的 cortico World 扩展：饱食度、米仓、电饭煲，外加一块水稻田、一个水池和虫灾鸟灾；桌宠用工具做饭、吃饭、种田、立稻草人，主人在控制台厨房/稻田面板直接操作；煮饭和水稻都要时间，下雨会替田里浇水，鸟先吃虫再吃稻子。 / A cortico World extension with satiety, a rice bin, a rice cooker, one rice paddy, a water pool, pests and birds: t
cortico-world-eat.author: AqualCross

cortico-world-ego.description: Ego 浏览器 —— 专为 AI 打造的浏览器 World，让你家的小肥鱼上网、看图、看视频更顺手。Cortico 与 Coopanion 共用官方 ego-browser 接口，在独立 Space 里开网页、点击填表、截图，观看 HTML5 / B 站视频的画面、字幕与弹幕。需先安装 Ego Lite。

en.description: Ego Browser — a browser built for AI, so your little fat fish (小肥鱼) browses, reads pages and watches videos more smoothly. For Cortico and Coopanion via the official ego-browser API: isolated task spaces, browsing, forms, screenshots, HTML5/Bilibili video frames, subtitles and danmaku. Requires an installed Ego Lite.

cortico-world-ego.author: 筆離嘢

cortico-world-fatfish.description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话让它帮你干活写代码，宠物回复时用内置语音包读出声（朗读支持 Windows 与 macOS）。桥接这半边需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件（coopanion-connector-dsh）才会连；不会装就看源码仓库的说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。/ Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work — writing code for you — and hear the pet's rep

zh.description: 和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话，让它帮你干活、写代码；宠物回复你的时候用内置语音包读出声（朗读支持 Windows 与 macOS）。桥接需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件才会连——不会装就看源码仓库说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。

en.description: Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work and writes code for you, and hear the pet's replies read aloud with built-in voices (Windows and macOS). The bridge needs the DSH Host extension installed first — if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it.

cortico-world-fatfish.author: blacksunshy

cortico-world-gaming-alont1.description: 在玩什么 World：读前台窗口知道你（主人）在玩哪款游戏、玩了多久，还能定期看一眼游戏画面——一局打完、局中击杀或买到新装备时递一句给你，平时安静地看着
cortico-world-gaming-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-gemini-web.description: Cortico 的 Gemini Web 内嵌 World（Windows）：提供 Gemini 原生网页、状态与窗口同步。必须与 cortico-provider-gemini-web 同时安装，二者互为刚需。

cortico-world-gpt-sovits-for-coopanion.description: Cortico World for Coopanion: speaks the pet's lines aloud with GPT-SoVITS (V5 on NVIDIA GPUs, a CPU tier otherwise), installing a portable runtime and weights in one click
cortico-world-gpt-sovits-for-coopanion.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-humanlike-alont1.description: 一些让 AI 更像人的功能：情绪与交情、作息、你们一起过的时间、时间感、学过的东西、它自己惦记的事，以及看得见你的桌面和花销——工具全部只读，不替它生成一个字
cortico-world-humanlike-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-image.description: 【0.3+仅支持0.2.4+的coopanion（支持官方qq插件和alont1 不再给coo本体打补丁）/0.2+支持0.2.0-0.2.3（支持alont1QQ）/再往前的版本装0.1.x的】Image Studio（图片工坊）—— 给 Coopanion 桌宠的 cortico World 扩展：用任意 OpenAI 兼容的图片接口画图/改图、落盘成作品库、把图贴进控制台「对话」页，并自带一套自动重打的自愈补丁。 / A cortico World extension that draws thro
cortico-world-image.author: lostdegree

cortico-world-imagekit-alont1.description: 图片与头像：搜图、下载图片、换 QQ 头像（NapCat set_qq_avatar）。让 bot 能自己找一张图当头像
cortico-world-imagekit-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-learn-alont1.description: 联网学习 World：遇到不懂的词自己上网查（B站/贴吧/萌娘百科），提炼出用法再记；也能记人和关系
cortico-world-learn-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-life-alont1.description: 生活状态 World：角色自己的一条时间线——这会儿在干嘛、心情如何、今天遇到了什么小事
cortico-world-life-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-listen.description: 听觉（Listen）—— 给 Coopanion 桌宠的 cortico World 扩展：监听系统声音或某个应用的音频，自动把语音切成块（能量门限或可选的 Silero VAD），并把每块作为事件投进 cortico 事件流（附件是 WAV），由 agent 决定接下来做什么（比如交给 stt_transcribe 转写成文字）。 / A cortico World extension that captures system or per-application audio, segments spe
cortico-world-listen.author: AqualCross

cortico-world-lite-alont1.description: 小模型专用 World：只给 4B 级小模型补两样东西——现在几点、以及记得他说过的事。3 个工具、提示词两百来字、没有任何主动推送与情绪机制，为的是不把小模型的上下文和指令空间挤爆
cortico-world-lite-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-localvision.description: 在本机把屏幕 OCR 成「文字 + 坐标」，默认不把截图发到云端，省掉每帧看屏的 token；可选接视觉模型，也可硬拦截内置截图。

zh.description: 在本机把屏幕 OCR 成「文字 + 坐标」，默认不上传截图，省掉每帧看屏的 token；可选接视觉模型看图，也可硬拦截内置截图。

en.description: Reads the screen locally with OCR and returns text with coordinates, keeping screenshots off the cloud by default. Optional vision model and built-in screenshot interception.

cortico-world-localvision.author: HY-pt

cortico-world-majsoul.description: 雀魂网页公开牌局、版本校验和动作回执
cortico-world-majsoul.author: Kpect10086

cortico-world-meme-alont1.description: 网络梗扩展：本地梗库 + 联网搜梗兜底，支持接龙真假判定与频率限制，让 bot 会接梗、不硬编、不刷屏
cortico-world-meme-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-memory.description: Cortico World 扩展：五层记忆（事实库/知识库/反思/人格/档案）+ 三级记忆底座 + Hybrid Recall 向量混合检索（移植自 E:/qq_bot 的记忆系统与 memory_server 向量 sidecar，qq_bot 源码零改动）。

cortico-world-memory-doctor-alont1.description: 记忆体检 World：报出她那份记忆的体重与结构——哪几份在长、交接笔记堆了多少、有没有同一句话散在多份文件里，该整理的时候她自己看得见。只看不写
cortico-world-memory-doctor-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-memsearch-alont1.description: 记忆检索：在自己的记忆/笔记里按关键词找原话（带文件名和行号），比翻文件快
cortico-world-memsearch-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-mind-alont1.description: 惦记 World（实验性）：她自己记下想做的事与时间，到点由框架把她自己的原话还给她——不是替她生成，也不是替她决定
cortico-world-mind-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-minecraft.description: Cortico World: Minecraft Java Edition through a Mineflayer player — observation text, movement, building, combat and an observer client
cortico-world-minecraft.author: Pal AI Lab

cortico-world-mood-alont1.description: 情绪天气 World：看她/他在不在电脑前、是在忙还是在玩，语气跟着变（Windows 专用，默认关闭）
cortico-world-mood-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-notes.description: Cortico World: a note keeper — record by talking, get reminded, and browse everything on a local page
cortico-world-notes.author: ding

cortico-world-onebot.description: 让TA使用QQ。连接到你的napcat或者snowluma，然后在QQ上和TA聊天吧。就像直接用QQ一样，使用几乎所有功能。
cortico-world-onebot.author: AqualCross

cortico-world-overcooked2.description: Cortico World for Overcooked! 2 local co-op: the bot joins as a second local player through a BepInEx plugin and plays next to the operator. 此乃直播测试验证之后的world，和其他 Persona / 非直播场景的兼容性有待测试。
cortico-world-overcooked2.author: Phantivia

cortico-world-perch.description: Coo walks along the top edge of any window and thunder-jumps between windows and the desktop floor.

zh.description: 让 Coo 站在任意窗口的顶边上行走，并在窗口之间雷霆大跳；支持多屏幕与指定落点。

en.description: Coo walks along the top edge of your windows and thunder-jumps between them; multi-monitor, with a chosen landing spot.

cortico-world-phone.description: Cortico World:电话 —— QQ 语音通话(走 QQ 自带的 AVSDK):她接得起真来电、听得见对方、说得出自己的话、挂断。★ 非即插即用:装之前先把它交给一个 coding agent,从 AGENTS.md 读起(真能力在另一台登着 QQ 的机器上)。作者已跑通并验证过的是服务器端那一套(NapCat);本机(Windows)那条路没有完全验证过 —— 社区里有人做过,可到 Cortico 社区群咨询。耳朵=本机语音识别,嗓子=TTS。
cortico-world-phone.author: 筆離嘢

cortico-world-phone-alont1.description: 手机：MuMu 模拟器就是她的手机，随时能开、能看屏幕、能点、能装应用、能敲命令
cortico-world-phone-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-playground-alont1.description: 玩具世界：在自己的 play/ 目录里写并跑一小段 JS，不联网、不碰外面文件、最多 5 秒。没有提醒，想起来才用
cortico-world-playground-alont1.author: ALonT1

cortico-world-presence.author: 筆離嘢

cortico-world-pvz.description: Cortico World: the original PopCap Plants vs. Zombies as a semantic, event-driven World — x86 implant, named-pipe bridge, task queue with receipts

cortico-world-python.description: Cortico World 扩展：通过 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接协议，让用 Python 编写的插件也能以原生 Cortico World 协议（工具 / 事件 / store）接入 agent。

cortico-world-qiandengji.description: 千灯纪 Minecraft server World for Cortico

cortico-world-qq.description: Cortico World: QQ group and private chats through a OneBot v11 forward WebSocket, with a draft-and-confirm gate on replies
cortico-world-qq.author: Pal AI Lab

cortico-world-qq-affinity.description: QQ 好感度系统功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。按用户记录关系分，注入语境。

cortico-world-qq-antiloop.description: QQ 防刷与话题结束功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。拦截刷屏/复读，并引导机器人不过度续话。

cortico-world-qq-better-alont1.description: QQ（OneBot v11 / NapCat）World：上游 cortico-world-qq-better 的本地副本，这台机器的改动都加在这里

cortico-world-qq-emotion.description: QQ 情绪感知功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。感知群氛围并注入提示词，影响语气。

cortico-world-qq-festival.description: QQ 节日/节气/农历感知功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。零依赖注入今日节日节气。

cortico-world-qq-final.description: Cortico World 扩展：QQ（OneBot v11 / NapCat）适配器。

cortico-world-qq-groupspeak.description: QQ 群聊限速功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。限制机器人在群内的发信频率，避免刷屏。

cortico-world-qq-lite.description: 轻量化 QQ 世界基础包（Cortico）。提供连接与监听、实时事件分发、监听名单、配置基础设施与提示词模板机制，并暴露插件宿主 API，供功能包（cortico-world-qq-*）按需挂载。已剔除 voxcpm 侧车、语音电话、桌宠、CUA。

cortico-world-qq-notebook.description: QQ 智能体笔记本功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。让 AI 记录/检索自己想记的东西。

cortico-world-qq-proactive.description: QQ 主动说话功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。定时/看群活跃度主动找人聊天、分享动态。

cortico-world-qq-promax.description: QQ ProMAX: Cortico QQ 私聊、群聊、空间和语音扩展，支持 OneBot v11 / SnowLuma / NapCat。

cortico-world-qq-qzone.description: QQ 空间动态感知功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。抓取 QQ 空间新鲜事，经 LLM 摘要后主动分享到群。

cortico-world-qq-reminder.description: QQ 提醒/记事功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。自然语言定时提醒，到点发到群/私聊。

cortico-world-qq-routine.description: QQ 作息功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。设定休息时段，休息时抑制响应并播报晚安/早安。

cortico-world-qq-sticker.description: QQ 表情包功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。按关键词匹配表情图片，通过 OneBot image 段发送。

cortico-world-qq-voice.description: QQ 语音收发功能包（依赖 cortico-world-qq-lite）。TTS/ASR 供应商注册表（native/custom/local），保留语音收发，剔除 voxcpm 侧车与语音电话。

cortico-world-simple-trpg-check.author: DTMosken

cortico-world-sisterdrive.description: Cortico World for Teach my little sister how to drive: a BepInEx plugin turns game calls into events and feeds the bot's voice to the game. 此乃直播测试验证之后的world，和其他 Persona / 非直播场景的兼容性有待测试。

cortico-world-snowluma.description: QQ（SnowLuma）—— 给 Coopanion 桌宠的 cortico World 扩展：接入 SnowLuma 的 OneBot v11，用一个通用 dispatcher 覆盖全部 action，用 raw 事件泵覆盖全部 event，并支持按配置禁用 action。 / A cortico World extension that connects to SnowLuma over OneBot v11, exposes every action through one generic disp

cortico-world-soft-voice.author: Asryto
